name: past.dev
description: Memory for AI agents. Send timestamped text and get back the facts that are current, each with its dated source and the history behind it, so an agent knows what changed and what it replaced. Ranked first on BEAM at every history size from 100K to 10M tokens, with the method and the evaluation harness published.
